transcript: I ranked it this way because it fits my personal beliefs. I believe that with the religious utopia, you're looking at something that has a firm foundation. Second best, I would do the primitive because that's kind of how God made us to begin with. The rest of them, I'm not very high on, but I would keep them in the order of futurist utopia. I feel like innovation is important. It embraces the ideas of capitalism. Institutional, I think the rule of law is always a good thing. I think it can become overbearing. Moral commonwealth, I think we read about that in the book of Judges. It's not a good thing. AI-centered utopia, I think that's what we're heading toward anyway. And then the modern green utopia also is something that we're kind of heading in the direction of that I think is not important or not good.
